items.claim: MT 41:12-41:26 carries two movements rather than one. The first is a measured accounting at 41:12-41:15: the measure verb stands at 41:13 and again at 41:15, and the hundred-cubit figure falls at 41:13, 41:14 and 41:15. The second is a description of finish, decoration and furnishings at 41:16-41:26 which carries no measure verb at any verse and no dimension at all until the wooden table at 41:22. Chapter 41 has no measure verb after 41:15, and 41:16-41:21 carries no measurement of any kind, so the measurement unit type answers to the first movement only.
items.both_sides: Close side at MT 41:15: the verse opens on the measure verb and ends the building accounting at a hundred cubits, and its final clause names the inner temple and the porches of the court. That naming is disclosed as continuity across the proposed seam, because 41:16 goes on to describe the thresholds, windows and galleries of exactly those structures; the seam still stands, because the verb and the figure both end at 41:15. Onset side at MT 41:16: the verse opens an inventory of thresholds, closed windows and galleries with no measure verb and no numeral, and nothing through 41:21 is measured. The division weighed in the record, between 41:20 and 41:21, has no Hebrew device on either of its sides: 41:20 ends the cherub-and-palm program and 41:21 opens on the doorposts of the nave. The nearest device to that division is the guide speech at 41:22, which stands after the table dimensions inside that same verse, so a seam there would separate those dimensions from the naming that follows them.

suggested_fix.fact: the measure verb in chapter 41 occurs at 41:13 and at 41:15 and at no later verse, and MT 41:16-41:21 carries no dimension of any kind

items.claim: MT 42:1-42:14 is one literary movement. The double transport at 42:1 takes the tour out to the chamber block, the north chambers are measured at 42:2-42:9, the second block at 42:10-42:12 is described by explicit comparison with the north one rather than opened independently, and the guide speech at 42:13-42:14 states what those same chambers are for, naming the north chambers and the south chambers together. Medium_low confidence matches the evidence: both edges rest on guide devices, and chapter 42 carries no Masoretic paragraph mark anywhere.
items.both_sides: Close side: the speech at MT 42:13 is one of the thirty-six verses carrying that form, and it is the device a division here would have to sit on. It is rightly held inside the unit, because the two verses it introduces name the very chambers measured at 42:1-42:12, and because 42:13-42:14 standing alone would be a two-verse unit with no word-event frame to license the size. Onset side at MT 42:15: the completion notice over the inner house together with the transport out is stronger than any division inside 42:1-42:14, including the one at 42:9/42:10, which 42:11 forecloses by describing the second block as matching the first in length, width, exits and doors.

suggested_fix.fact: the guide speech at MT 42:13 names the north chambers and the south chambers together, and those are the chambers measured at MT 42:1-42:12

items.claim: The ketiv/qere at MT 42:16 falls on the numeral word itself and not beside it. The ketiv is the measure noun for cubits and the qere is the numeral for hundreds, while the other three sides at 42:17, 42:18 and 42:19 all read five hundred. The variant therefore governs whether the east side measures five or five hundred, and the stated reading that it is a lexical variant which is not a numeral and does not affect the reed count does not hold. The generalization that the chapter-40 ketiv/qere forms stand beside a number and never on it is true of that cluster and does not reach MT 42:16.
items.both_sides: The boundary is unaffected and holds from both sides. Close side at MT 42:20: the verse ends on the purpose of the wall, לְהַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לְחֹֽל, which is a terminal clause and rests on no disputed reading. Onset side at MT 43:1: the guide transport with the glory approaching behind it opens a different device family from measurement. What the variant does bear on is the unit internal shape, which is the evidence that 42:15-42:20 is a single movement: under the qere the four sides are one symmetrical five-hundred circuit, and under the ketiv the east side alone would break that symmetry.

suggested_fix.fact: at MT 42:16 the ketiv is the measure noun and the qere is the numeral for hundreds, and the three parallel sides at MT 42:17, 42:18 and 42:19 read five hundred

items.claim: MT 43:1-43:9 is one movement with the best-marked close in these four chapters. The guide transport at 43:1, the glory arriving from the east at 43:2 and entering the house at 43:4, the transport into the inner court at 43:5, the voice from the house at 43:6, the son-of-man address opening the throne declaration at 43:7, the defilement charge at 43:8 and the dwelling resolution at 43:9 form one scene, and a samekh follows 43:9 - the first Masoretic paragraph mark in the hundred and three verses from MT 40:1 to MT 43:8, single witness. Medium confidence is matched by the evidence on both edges.
items.both_sides: Close side: MT 43:9 ends on the dwelling resolution, the paragraph mark follows it, and 43:10 opens a fresh address to the prophet. Onset side: MT 43:1 stands behind a closed measuring circuit, and the glory devices at 43:4 and 43:5 belong to the vision family rather than to measurement. The one candidate division inside the unit is the transport at 43:5 itself; it is rightly not taken, because 43:4 and 43:5 are the single act of the glory entering and the prophet being carried in after it, and because the declaration at 43:7 is what the arrival is staged to deliver.

suggested_fix.fact: the paragraph mark after MT 43:9 is the first in the hundred and three verses from MT 40:1 to MT 43:8, single witness

items.claim: The doubled torah-of-the-house formula is contained inside MT 43:12. The verse opens זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֣ת הַבָּ֑יִת and closes הִנֵּה זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֥ת הַבָּֽיִת, so the repetition brackets that one verse and not the span 43:10-43:12. Stating it as a self-contained frame around 43:10-43:12 which a larger unit would have to break through overstates the extent of the device, and the same record elsewhere states the fact correctly as a repetition at the head and the foot of one verse, so the two accounts of one fact disagree.
items.both_sides: The three-verse unit still holds, on grounds other than the extent of the frame. Close side: the second instance of the formula at MT 43:12 is a genuine terminal device, and the next verse opens a labelled list, וְאֵ֨לֶּה מִדּ֤וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙, whose subject is dimensions rather than law. Onset side: MT 43:10 opens אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֗ם, a fresh address to the prophet, with the paragraph mark after 43:9 behind it and the dwelling resolution of 43:9 closing the unit before it. What changes is the warrant: the size of this unit is carried by the address at its head and the terminal formula at 43:12, not by a frame spanning three verses.

suggested_fix.fact: both instances of the torah-of-the-house formula stand inside MT 43:12, at its head and at its foot

items.claim: In MT 43:13-43:17 the ketiv/qere reading pair stands at 43:16 alone. MT 43:16 opens with an unpointed ketiv, whereas every word of MT 43:15 is pointed and the marks inventory records no ketiv/qere at that verse. What MT 43:15 carries is two OSHB editorial notes, one marking an anomalous form and one recording a ketiv/qere decision taken against BHS. Resting a ketiv/qere claim on such a note is permitted where the note is named, and the note is named here; what does not hold is counting MT 43:15 as a second ketiv/qere verse beside 43:16, which adds a note-borne claim to an inventory verse as though the two were one class.
items.both_sides: The boundary is unaffected. Close side at MT 43:17: the altar dimensions and the steps complete there with no reading in dispute, and the twelve-by-twelve at 43:16 and the fourteen-by-fourteen at 43:17 are both undisputed, the contested word at 43:16 being the hearth noun. Onset side at MT 43:13: the labelled list header opens the dimensions directly after the terminal formula of 43:12, and on the far side MT 43:18 opens with the guide speech and the messenger formula. The conclusion that no measurement figure in this unit is in dispute is correct; it rests on one ketiv/qere verse and not on two.

suggested_fix.fact: the only ketiv/qere reading pair in MT 43:13-43:17 stands at 43:16, and MT 43:15 carries editorial notes rather than a reading pair

items.claim: MT 43:18 opens with the guide speech, וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י, before the son-of-man address and the messenger formula. It is one of the thirty-six verses in the book carrying that speech form, and inside a vision a unit discloses the speech verse it opens on. The onset account names the address and the messenger formula but not the speech verb, and states that the verse opens on the address, which is not what stands at its head. The same device is treated as boundary-grade at MT 42:13 and deliberately contrasted against the other speech root at MT 41:22, so the omission is inconsistent within one stretch of text.
items.both_sides: The boundary is right and the correction only strengthens it. Onset side at MT 43:18: three devices stack in one verse - the guide speech, the son-of-man address and the messenger formula - and the material turns from the altar dimensions to the altar ordinances. Close side at MT 43:27: the utterance signature ends the unit, אֶתְכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה, and two consecutive samekh marks follow it on that verse, the one verse in the book carrying two of them, single witness; the utterance at 43:19 is paragraph-final inside the unit because the seven-day instructions run on past it through 43:25 and 43:26. On the far side MT 44:1 opens with its own transport.

suggested_fix.fact: MT 43:18 opens with the guide speech verb, ahead of the son-of-man address and the messenger formula

unresolved_uncertainty.what: Every row in this cluster sits inside the dateline block opened at MT 40:1, and none of the seven names that block; the row schema carries no field for it.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: The corpus requires each unit to disclose its dated block, so either the disclosure is missing across the whole cluster or the requirement was changed. This lane cannot tell which from what it reads, so it is recorded once as a uniform question rather than as seven separate findings.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: Where the paragraph mark after MT 43:9 and the two after MT 43:27 fall within their verses cannot be settled from the staged extract, and the same limit applies to the disjunctive stroke counts in chapters 41, 42 and 43.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: Two of the units in this cluster take their strongest corroboration from those marks. The counts are usable as they stand and the positions are not, so a reading that depended on position would be unsupported.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: Whether the seam inside MT 41:12-41:26 belongs at 41:16 or at 41:15 turns on how the closing clause of 41:15 is weighed, since it names the structures the following description then takes up.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: This lane places 41:15 with the measured accounting because the measure verb and the hundred-cubit figure are both in that verse, but a reading that treats the naming clause as the head of the description would put the seam one verse earlier. The two-movement finding is the same either way; only the exact verse moves.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: Whether any ketiv/qere outside the chapter-40 cluster other than MT 42:16 falls on a numeral was not swept across the book by this lane.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: The finding at 42:16 is therefore stated for that verse and its three parallel sides only, and is not offered as a book-wide count or as an exclusivity claim.
